source_matrix.policy: The original20 acceptance/scenario/evidence strings are copied verbatim. Historical ENG_* labels are preserved as source metadata and are not current test results.

policy: No row is prefilled as passing or as having executed.
An aggregate row is PASS only when all stated acceptance variants have actual bound evidence; otherwise record precise subresults and PARTIAL/NOT_RUN/blocked status.
A source/backend/Editor/accelerated-fixture check must retain that scope and cannot be relabelled ordinary physical touch, human campaign, live provider or all-device acceptance.
Do not waive failures or count attempted checks in failed runs as passing.
No credentials, payment tokens, personal clipboard content, recovery codes or unrelated phone data belong in evidence.

rows.scenario: Install development APK on authorized ARM64 Android phone
rows.acceptance: App starts without crash and version is recorded
rows.evidence_required: APK hash and device OS model and logcat
rows.planned_scope: Authorized physical ARM64 phone, accepted checkpoint86 APK, package/version/signer and app-scoped startup only.
prerequisites: Explicit selected physical-device serial
Existing package/save/attempt inventory before installation
safeguards: Use replacement installation only when compatible; never uninstall or clear data as fallback
Do not inspect unrelated installed apps or private phone files
excluded_claims: Launch does not establish all-checklist acceptance

rows.scenario: Fresh install with no prior profile
rows.acceptance: Approved first-start appears and Home does not bootstrap demo progression
rows.evidence_required: Video and initial state
rows.planned_scope: Fresh first-start and returning-player launch routes are separate cases.
prerequisites: Naturally absent profile or separately authorized isolated fresh profile
safeguards: Preserve any existing onboarding/progression state
excluded_claims: Do not manufacture fresh state by clearing an owner save

Known expected attempt and all eight inventory fields

Retain failed recovery evidence
